text:
maria_pm: Heads-up: Hosted Realtime + Tool-Calling is GA today. This release unifies streaming (WS/SSE/WebRTC) with server-enforced tool schemas and regional low-latency endpoints. Please skim the rollout notes and share any blockers. :sparkles:

jack_runtime: Amazing work, team. Key infra notes: new LLI scheduler, token-aware batching, and kernel auto-selection for quantized models.

deploy-bot: rollout started: realtime-service v2.1.0 -> us-east-1 (canary 5%), eu-west-1 (canary 5%)

maria_pm: Quick product summary for internal teams:
- New API surface: POST /v1/realtime/sessions (WebSocket + WebRTC), POST /v1/realtime/events (SSE)
- Tool-calling: functions declared in the request are validated server-side; mismatched types will return a structured error (400.function_mismatch)
- Backwards compatibility: legacy streaming clients will be supported for 120 days; please migrate sooner for best performance.

lee_devex: Docs/migration: https://console.redwood.ai/docs/realtime-ga-migrate (includes Node, Python, and browser WebRTC samples)

ops_bot: SLA note: low-latency endpoints target 99.9% uptime. Perf targets: p50=20ms, p95=40ms for token generation on our benchmark suite.

jack_runtime: Routing/fallback: smart-router will fall back to the standard hosted pool if LLI capacity is exhausted. Fallback events are instrumented as metric realtime.fallback.counttag=ll-rollback. Ops, please add alerts.

maria_pm: Rollout timeline:
- Today: canary (5%) in US/EU regions
- 72h: expand to 50% if stable
- 10 days: full GA with opt-in LLI allocation for hosted accounts

lee_devex: Example WebSocket client (Node):
```js
const ws = new WebSocket('wss://api.redwood.ai/v1/realtime/sessions', {
  headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${REDWOOD_KEY}` }
});
ws.on('open', () => {
  ws.send(JSON.stringify({ model: 'rwft-realtime-1', features: ['tool-calling'], functions: [{name: 'search', params: {query: 'string'}}] }));
});
ws.on('message', (msg) => console.log(msg));
```

maria_pm: Pricing: LLI is a separate SKU (LLI-Plus). Usage for GA customers will be opt-in. Customer Success will coordinate quota/price changes.

jack_runtime: Canary perf (initial): p50=18ms, p95=36ms, error rate 0.3% (mostly client-compatibility errors). We've added extra debug traces for canary traffic for 5 days.

ops_bot: note: auto-fallback is enabled. If fallback rate > 0.5% over 5m, automated rollback will be considered.

maria_pm: Action items:
- Eng/runtime: monitor realtime.fallback and realtime.errors, post any anomalies to #eng-runtime
- DevEx: update SDK quickstarts and add migration checklist (lee is owner)
- Support/CS: prepare a FAQ and an opt-in flow for customers who want LLI now

jack_runtime: If you find any regressions, include trace-id + request headers and ping #eng-runtime. We'll keep heightened sampling for 72h.

maria_pm: Thanks everyone. Big milestone for making production LLM features snappier. Please RT to your squads and mention any external customers we should notify. :rocket:
